label: Parte 3
subtitle: Comparar 2 fotos · 45 seg cada respuesta
objetivo: Comparar y contrastar con conectores de contraste fuertes (whereas, while, however) y preferencia razonada con condicional 2.

pasos.title: Apertura comparativa

alternativas.texto: At first sight, both pictures show
Straight away, I can tell that both

plantilla_segmentos.texto: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to

tema_general.ayuda: Categoría que abarca ambas: work, education, leisure, etc.

pasos.trick: Una sola frase de apertura te ahorra pensar 5 segundos. Memorízala.

pasos.title: Similitudes

alternativas.texto: What they have in common is

plantilla_segmentos.texto: , and in both of them, the people seem

comun.ayuda: Algo que se da en las dos fotos.

sentimiento.ayuda: Adjetivo que aplique a las personas de las dos fotos.

pasos.trick: Si no encuentras similitud clara, 'people interacting' funciona para casi todo.

pasos.title: Diferencias (lo más importante)

plantilla_segmentos.texto: However, the main difference is that in the first picture

opciones.texto: several colleagues are interacting in an office
the setting is indoors and formal

foto2.ayuda: Detalle opuesto al de la foto 1.

opciones.texto: a person is working alone from home
the setting is outdoors and relaxed

pasos.trick: 'Whereas' es el conector REY de Parte 3. Memorízalo. Es B2 alto sin esfuerzo.

pasos.title: Preferencia personal con condicional 2

plantilla_segmentos.texto: If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards

razon.ayuda: Por qué la prefieres. Mejor algo personal.

opciones.texto: it fits the way I work

pasos.trick: 'Lean towards' es phrasal verb B2 — mejor que 'prefer'. + condicional 2 = doble jugada.
pasos.warning: 'If I would choose, I would…' = ERROR. La condición SIEMPRE va en pasado: 'If I HAD to choose, I WOULD…'

temas.label: Oficina vs Casa
temas.descripcion_fotos: Foto 1: oficina moderna. Foto 2: persona trabajando desde casa.

bloque_a: Describe and compare what you see.
Tell me about the differences and similarities.
bloque_b: Which working environment would you prefer?
Where would you be more productive?
Have you ever worked in both?
bloque_c: How has remote work changed our lives?
Will offices disappear in the future?
Why has working from home become so common?

temas.respuesta_modelo: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to work, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show people engaged in their professional tasks, and in both of them they seem focused. However, the main difference is that in the first picture several colleagues are interacting in an office, whereas in the second one a person is working alone from home. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards working from home, because it gives me more flexibility. It's far more convenient for someone like me.

bloque_c: Will printed books disappear?

temas.respuesta_modelo: At first sight, both pictures show situations related to reading, but in completely different contexts. Both pictures show people engaged in books, and in both of them they seem focused. However, the main difference is that in the first picture readers are using printed books, whereas in the second one they're reading from digital devices. If I had to choose, I would personally lean towards printed books, because the feel of paper helps me concentrate. It's far more enjoyable for someone like me.
